distributionLeakage.verdict: The Phase 2 distribution result is partly circular. Most Cohort C negatives were hypothesised BECAUSE I believed the company was distributor-led, and Cohort B was sampled from distributor lists. Measuring distributor-carriage against those labels partly measures my own priors.
